    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    VERANDA is built on the conviction that hospitality fluency is a strategic capability — not a soft skill. Every module pairs business-English precision with service judgment, guest literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium hospitality leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern hospitality — from the foundations of front desk service and housekeeping to AI-powered guest services and smart hotels.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — guest recovery, revenue reviews, event coordination, brand standards — written for international hospitality professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. VERANDA reflects his vision: hospitality fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and genuine warmth.

    Designed for the hoteliers, guest service leads, and hospitality leaders shaping how the world travels and stays — VERANDA is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for making a stranger feel truly welcome.
